description: Source file implementing the speech data transfer protocol, including session management, connection handling, message queuing, and event-driven state machine logic for XR voice SDK.

methods.name: xrsr_protocol_handler_sdt
methods.description: Starts a new speech data transfer session with specified parameters.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_init
methods.description: Initializes the speech data transfer state structure.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_term
methods.description: Terminates the speech data transfer session.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_fd_set
methods.description: Sets file descriptors for select() based on connection state.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_handle_fds
methods.description: Handles activity on file descriptors, such as reading audio data.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_process_timeout
methods.description: Handles timeout events for the session.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection for the session.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_connect_new
methods.description: Attempts a new connection based on URL parameters.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_conn_is_ready
methods.description: Checks if the connection is ready.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_terminate
methods.description: Terminates the current session.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_audio_stream
methods.description: Starts streaming audio data into the session.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_read_pending
methods.description: Checks if there are pending reads.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_send_binary
methods.description: Sends binary data over the session.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_send_text
methods.description: Sends text data over the session.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_speech_stream_end
methods.description: Ends the speech stream with a specified reason.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_speech_session_end
methods.description: Ends the speech session with a specified reason.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_handle_speech_event
methods.description: Handles speech-related events.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_queue_msg_out
methods.description: Queues an outgoing message.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_clear_msg_out
methods.description: Clears queued outgoing messages.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_reset
methods.description: Resets the session state.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_is_established
methods.description: Checks if the session is established.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_is_disconnected
methods.description: Checks if the session is disconnected.
